from the Consolidated Fund;
“arrears”  means  financial  liabilities  unpaid  at  the
maturity date, the latter established by written
law or by contract, should the maturity not be
established  by  either  of  the  mechanisms

established as ninety days from the date of the
relevant invoice or of satisfaction of the terms of

District  Secretariats  of  the  Government  and
special  spending  units;
